title: Big question
text: Animals and plants, land and sea.
All these things are important to me.
I want to live a life that is green,
And keep our planet healthy and clean.
I can turn off lights and walk to school.
use both sides of the paper
How can you live a green life?
To list different ways to go green
To ask about other people's plans
To make an action plan for helping the Earth
Look at the picture. Who can you see? What are they doing?
Listen to the poem and read aloud.
Think about answers to the big question.
